Player Impressions:
Hoyos - Suddenly having trouble with his distribution, once his strength.  He was making good saves tonight.
Tomás - Good along the back, making good runs.  A solid game with nothing lacking.
Gregersen - He comes out of nowhere to clear breakaways that he has no business getting to.  Is a pain magnet
Mihaj - Very shaky at the start - his giveaway caused the Montréal goal
Amador - had good and bad moments.  
Muyumba - another good night.  Has re-found his form
Sanchez - unstoppable tonight.  Trying to claim and keep the starting spot
Galarza - invisible at times, can make some great flicks
Miranchuk - best match he's ever played.  near perfect on the night.  Is good on and off the ball.  
Saba - Has trouble with the final ball into the box, but what runs tonight.  He played on instinct, was on fire
Latte Lath - Still came too deep at times.  Turned off the jets at times.  But he scored.  A good goal.  Great to see.  The team rallied around him
Fortune - didn't influence the game like he normally does.  missed some easy balls.
Berrocal - didn't influence the game
Edwards - wasn't great, but held the team together emotionally.  Drove the team forward with his rallying
Brennan - Getting into good spots.  Lost the ball a few times.  Given more of a chance, the same balls could have found their targets
Edwards, shirtless and flexing, cheering on the gathered crowd as he walks down the tunnel.  Like a gladiator
MOTM - Alexey, with Saba a close 2nd
